limits: Do not tap DEV grants, claim, create, equip, upgrade or submit formation.
Home roster article/name/HP/SP meters and resource spans are display-only, not invented buttons.
AccountSave.readForUid is frozen API; no claim that mutating its returned copy changes canonical save.
Summary loading is an initial ensureShell placeholder; sync() with unavailable save only flips ready=false, does not reset old loaded markup. Do not fake DOM reset and call it production loading.
prepareFirstScreenVisuals rejects and clears its cached promise; no standalone summary failure/retry button exists in this Owner. API readiness retry is not a player-visible retry control.
